title: Each row of the / command list wears its own icon
goal: Typing / in Ask lists the commands you can run, and today every row in an area shows that area's one icon, where the mock gives each command its own. Give each row its own icon so the list can be read at a glance.
notes: Left by typing-in-ask-lists-the-commands-you-can-run. Mock: askPalHTML in docs/design/mocks/shared/dist/photonz-ds.js. AskConversationLines and AskCommandsList.symbol in Sources/Photonz/Agent/AskViews.swift; AppCommandTable has no icon today. New Conversation has to decide what Ask forgets: its memory of what it made comes from the rows (AskSession.conversation). DONE 2026-11-10: AppCommandID.symbol (exhaustive switch) + AskCommandEntry.symbol (choice overrides for align/spaceEvenly) in Sources/PhotonzCore/AppCommandSymbols.swift; AskViews uses entry.symbol. Tests: AppCommandSymbolTests (core), AppCommandSymbolsDrawTests (render, NSImage(systemSymbolName:)). Mock: removed New conversation button from shared/components/shell.js (dist rebuilt, untracked).
acceptance: Each row of the / list shows an icon for that command, as agent-generate-wt.html does, not one shared by its whole area
No two commands share an icon unless they share their words, checked by a test
Every icon names a symbol the Mac can draw, checked by a test on CI's macOS
The shared mock's Ask dialog no longer draws the New conversation button the user removed on 2026-11-04

log.note: digest 2026-11-04 spot check: the mock has it (askPalHTML: a button titled New conversation in the chat header, one icon per row from ASK_CMDS). A shortfall against the mock on the focus epic, so it stays p1.

digest 2026-11-05: narrowed to the icons. The first two items were a New Conversation button and a whole transcript in the chat, and the user took that chat out on 2026-11-04 (one-agent-pane-on-the-right-a-plain-history-of-r, 3bc0e202: the composer closes after a request and the Agent group is the one Agent place; ask.md says the same). Building them now would put back what the user removed. The shared mock's askPalHTML in photonz-ds.js still draws the New conversation button; the Ask pages were updated that day and this one was missed, so take it out while here.

Adversarial: a person scanning / wants to spot the row by shape; one icon per area (40 timeline rows, one film strip) made the icons noise. Mock rows each have their own glyph. Risk: ~250 commands, some icons inevitably abstract; kept each distinct and checked them all draw. Fade rows never appear in / (two required values), so no per-choice icon for them. Chose Mac system symbols over porting the mock's glyph set because every other icon in the app is one. Chose per-choice icons for Align and Space Evenly only, since only there do the choices differ in shape.

left rough: the / list draws Mac system symbols, not the mock's ic-* glyphs (the app draws every chrome icon that way); asked in the audit's evaluate list rather than filed, since it is app-wide and not a defect of this list.

Every / row in Ask now wears its own icon (AppCommandID.symbol, an exhaustive switch over all commands; Align and Space Evenly rows show their own edge/axis). Full Scripts/test.sh green (exit 0); ask-slash-lists-commands-walk (new Align step) and ask-lists-commands-in-the-panel-walk ok at Next defaults with real captures.
